name: Promptor
author: Corrplus

sections.description:
Transform Your Website into an AI-Powered Sales Expert!

Promptor is more than just a chatbot. It’s an advanced AI system that understands your visitors’ needs by learning from your own website content. What truly sets Promptor apart is its flexibility: you are not limited by post types. You can tag any page, post, or even a WooCommerce product as a “Service”, “Blog Post”, or “FAQ” within each unique Knowledge Base. This allows the AI to provide accurate, human-like answers and intelligently guide users to the right solutions, regardless of how your site is structured.

Stop losing potential customers to confusing navigation or static contact forms. With Promptor, you can offer an interactive, 24/7 assistant that boosts engagement, increases sales, and captures valuable leads directly from the conversation.

Core Features (Free Version):

  • Core AI Chat: Engage users with an interactive chat powered by OpenAI’s latest models.
  • Knowledge Base: Train your AI on your WordPress pages and posts to provide contextual answers (up to 3 content items).
  • Basic Lead Management: View the latest inquiries submitted through the chat.
  • Easy Setup: Get your AI assistant running in minutes with a simple settings panel and a [promptor_search] shortcode.

Upgrade to Promptor Pro for a True Powerhouse:

  • Unlimited Knowledge Base: Train the AI on unlimited pages, posts, PDFs, and documents.
  • Website Crawler: Automatically index your entire website from your sitemap to keep the AI’s knowledge always up-to-date.
  • Smart WooCommerce Integration: The AI recommends products with images and prices, and users can add them to the cart directly from the chat.
  • Performance Dashboard: A comprehensive analytics dashboard to track queries, leads, conversion rates, and AI-driven revenue.
  • Advanced Lead Management: Manage all leads in a dedicated table with statuses like “Pending,” “Contacted,” and “Converted”.
  • Full UI Customization: Match the chat widget to your brand identity by customizing colors, texts, avatars, position (inline or popup), and more.
  • Instant Notifications: Get real-time alerts for new leads via Email and Slack.
  • Remove “Powered by” Branding: Offer a complete white-label experience.
  • Priority Support: Get faster, prioritized help from our team.

Find out more at promptorai.com.

External Services

This plugin connects to the OpenAI API to provide its core functionality. An OpenAI account and a valid API key are required for the plugin to work.

  • Service: OpenAI API
  • Purpose: This service is used to generate AI-powered chat responses and to create semantic vector embeddings from your website’s content, which form the knowledge base for the chatbot.
  • Data Sent: When a user interacts with the chat, their query is sent to OpenAI. When an administrator syncs the knowledge base, the text content of the selected pages, posts, or files is sent to OpenAI to be processed. Your private OpenAI API key is also sent with each request for authentication.
  • Links: OpenAI Terms of Use | OpenAI Privacy Policy
sections.installation:
From your WordPress dashboard:

  1. Navigate to ‘Plugins’ > ‘Add New’.
  2. Search for ‘Promptor’.
  3. Click ‘Install Now’ and then ‘Activate’.
  4. Go to the new ‘Promptor’ menu in your admin sidebar and follow the Quick Start Guide.

Manual installation:

  1. Download the plugin zip file from WordPress.org.
  2. Unzip the file and upload the promptor folder to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  3. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  4. Go to the ‘Promptor’ > ‘Settings’ menu to configure your API key and knowledge base.
sections.faq:
What do I need to get started?

You need an API key from OpenAI. You can get one from the OpenAI Platform.

How do I display the chat on my site?

Simply place the [promptor_search] shortcode on any page or post. The Pro version also offers a floating popup widget option.

Does this work with any theme?

Yes, Promptor is designed to work with any standard WordPress theme. You can customize its appearance from the UI Settings to match your brand.

What languages does it support?

Promptor automatically detects the user’s language and responds in the same language. You can translate all front-end text strings using standard WordPress translation methods.

Is it compatible with WooCommerce?

Yes! The Pro version features deep integration with WooCommerce, allowing the AI to recommend products and users to add them to the cart from the chat window.

  • Enhanced: FAQ accordion improvements with rotating arrows and question mark icons
  • Enhanced: PDF cards with red icon, file size display, and download button (Pro)

  • Improved: Better spacing between service chips for improved readability
  • Fixed: Quote form width issues on desktop resolved
  • Fixed: Duplicate quote form prevention
  • Fixed: PDF Files tab now visible in Knowledge Base settings (Pro)

1.0.1

  • Improved: Translation system completely rebuilt for better multilingual support
  • Added: Smart pagination for Knowledge Base content – easily manage thousands of pages with “Load More” feature
  • Added: Real-time selection counter and bulk selection tools for faster content management
  • Enhanced: AI-powered example questions generator now works perfectly with multilingual content
  • Fixed: Frontend translations now display correctly (Related Articles, example questions, etc.)
  • Fixed: Various translation and language detection improvements throughout the plugin
  • Fixed: CRITICAL – Save now preserves all previously selected items, even when using Load More pagination
  • Optimized: Better performance when managing large content libraries

1.0.0

  • Initial Release!

  • Advanced dashboard and lead management system in the Pro version.
